risk.rationale: Verified evidence forms a complete confirmed account takeover chain: phishing mail from aegean-edu.co delivered (F5), user clicked the malicious link (F1), MFA fatigue with 7 denials then 1 approval from 185.220.101.7 (F4), bulk SIS access (38 events in 60 min) from the same IP 185.220.101.7 (F2), impossible travel Amsterdam→Manisa consistent with that session (F3), and an API-created inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (F8) indicating persistence/exfiltration. The rejected password-spray claim (193.140.10.44) is shared background egress noise and does not weaken this chain. All key findings are CONFIRMED and mutually consistent, meeting the contain threshold.
